scientific_question: Given a frozen candidate EOG transition rule universe and positive-occurrence roster, how much of rule compatibility is contingent on choosing one hypothetical FIXED source rather than another?
prior_art: docs/eog_original_idea_world_universe_v6_result.md already established certificate persistence after SOURCE+barrier+analyst world-universe growth; v8 quantified lifetime/threatened certificates. This new API does not rescore those experiments, expand their world universe, or repeat their closed endpoint.

api_scope.inputs: same Mapping[str,DynamicTransitionOperator] for every hypothesis; same full positive node IDs, max_steps, support_floor, support_tolerance; candidate_source_hypotheses mapping hypothesis_id→one or more distinct source IDs explicitly included in positive roster; every hypothesis leaves >=1 non-source target.
api_scope.calculation: For each source hypothesis, call existing compare_occurrence_transition_rules with fixed_source_ids and report rule IDs compatible with all remaining observed positive targets. Count source-robust rule IDs in intersection, source-possible rule IDs in union, source-dependent rule IDs in union minus intersection, and impossible-under-all-declared-source-hypotheses IDs in complement.
api_scope.claim_boundary: source IDs are candidate assumptions, not verified ancestral sources, current-state colonization evidence or calibrated movement probabilities. This is a static comparison, not annual sequential_world_forecast. Do not label source-hypothesis intersection as ecological robustness outside the finite declared candidate universe.
api_scope.fail_closed: Reject empty operator/hypothesis mapping, duplicate/unknown source IDs, hypothesis keys collision/blank, sources not in positive observations, source set consuming all observations, operators with mismatched node IDs/order, numeric contract invalid; never open or fit response data.

known_truth_synthetic_test.proof: Each of three source alternatives forces the two outgoing edges from that source; 16 graphs per source. Pairwise intersections force four distinct edges, each 4 graphs; triple intersection forces six edges, 1 graph. Inclusion-exclusion union = 3·16−3·4+1=37. Intersection=1.

stop.original_wetland_source_only: Existing PR #697 contains real observed source-positive method/date provenance but no confirmed ancestral sources; do not apply synthetic graph source hypotheses as real wetland movements.
